input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Explore: build a random-effects meta-analysis research tool (ventures/meta-analysis)
errors: Two unguarded METHODS[o.method] lookups were caught by venture-preflight's inherited_keys lint and fixed before push.
The new page was a crawlable orphan (siblings budget 0); fixed with a link from fdr-multiple-testing.

Asserting metafor's printed meta-regression digits exactly failed in the 4th decimal (tau2 0.076348 vs metafor 0.0764), because metafor stops at its own convergence threshold; the test now checks within 1.5 units of the last printed digit and the README says why.
integrity_issues: Crossref and jstatsoft.org returned 403 through the proxy, so three citations from memory (Hartung & Knapp 2001, Higgins/Thompson/Spiegelhalter 2009, Partlett & Riley 2017) could not be checked. They were replaced with references whose full details appear in metafor's Rd files on raw.githubusercontent.com (Knapp & Hartung 2003, Riley/Higgins/Deeks 2011) or dropped. Every remaining citation was checked against those Rd files.
A sentence in the draft post said latitude was 'the point Colditz et al. made in 1994'. No accessible source confirmed it, so it was removed before commit.

doc_friction.issue: Points to pyenv.py for numpy/pytest. It reported success for 'numpy scipy statsmodels' but printed an interpreter (/usr/bin/python3.13) that was not the python3 on PATH, so `python3 -c 'import statsmodels'` failed until I used the printed path.

The citation rule says to 'check every citation', but Crossref, doi.org and journal sites are blocked through the proxy. raw.githubusercontent.com reference lists (e.g. an R package's man/*.Rd) were the only way to check. A note on that route would save time.

notes: Explore idea: random-effects meta-analysis as the 24th research-algorithm tool (no venture pooled study results). Verification: 36 node tests; statsmodels 0.15.0 / scipy reference agrees to 1e-9 for closed-form results and 1e-6 for iterative ones; metafor README output matched to every digit for the RE model and within 1.5 units of the last printed digit for the meta-regression. Coverage simulation (2000 reps x 6 settings): Wald 87-94%, Knapp-Hartung 93-96%, prediction interval 85-93%. venture-preflight clean (main_health, site tests, build + check.mjs). Local checks were run because CI status had not been read yet; see the PR for CI.
